dedupe_keys.name: irridrone sprinkler irrigation videos and water discharge measurements

description: IrriDrone is a public Zenodo release of overhead drone videos and paired water-discharge observations from working sprinkler irrigation in Ghoruchay village, Kurdistan Province, Iran. The article describes carrot, potato and alfalfa fields, arrangements with three, six or nine sprinklers, and 674 paired rotations represented by 1,348 video clips. Zenodo lists twenty large ZIP parts and states CC BY 4.0. The footage is an observation source for vision-based sprinkler assessment and water-use modelling, not a complete hydraulic network description or a controller ready to run. The single village, chosen crops, camera viewpoint and very large file volume are limitations for transfer and practical reuse. A reviewer-assessed use is checking irrigation-state detection or discharge estimates in a farm water simulation. model-fao-cropwat is a related crop-water planning model, but the videos have not been converted to its inputs. Repository metadata and the file inventory were checked without downloading any video or archive. Geographic coverage is limited to the observed farm fields in one village.
